root_cause.text: In `krb5enc_dispatch_decrypt()`, the asynchronous skcipher completion callback was incorrectly set to `req->base.complete` (the caller’s completion handler) instead of an intermediate function, causing the integrity verification (hash check) to be skipped entirely when the decryption completes asynchronously.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states: "krb5enc_dispatch_decrypt() sets req->base.complete as the skcipher callback, which is the caller's own completion handler. When the skcipher completes asynchronously, this signals 'done' to the caller without executing krb5enc_dispatch_decrypt_hash(), completely bypassing the integrity verification (hash check)." The patch fixes this by replacing `req->base.complete` with the newly added `krb5enc_decrypt_done` callback, which chains into `krb5enc_dispatch_decrypt_hash()`.
